reviews.rationale: PASS for the Phase 4D visual-direction gate. The direction reads as a credible professional consultancy: hierarchy is immediate, the ruled headings and numbered service treatment form one coherent visual language, contact actions are clear, and the mobile composition makes an intentional conversion-first change by bringing contact ahead of the service list. The figure-index distinctive moment is restrained but appropriate to a quantity-surveying practice rather than decorative. This verdict does not claim boutique-agency or corpus-level 9/10 proof; it says this candidate is the stronger complete visual answer in this bounded NBM set.

REWORK. The desktop direction is coherent and more editorially distinctive, but the mobile composition does not clear the responsive-quality criterion. The inline-scroll navigation and stacked company name make the header cramped and visually unfinished at 390px, and the direction largely preserves desktop ordering instead of making a stronger mobile conversion decision. Keep the editorial-row and lead-statement strengths, but redesign the mobile header/navigation and re-evaluate mobile hierarchy before this direction is considered promotable.

promote.rationale: Promoted because it is the only candidate in this set with a passing independent visual verdict. It provides the stronger combination of professional credibility, coherent hierarchy, clear conversion path and deliberate mobile composition while preserving the same frozen NBM product truth.
